objective: Reemitir GATE 1 READ_ONLY_SQL para Centro de Control EDARSA y Monitor de Sincronizacion. Obtener evidencia canonica del SQL real antes de cualquier implementacion. Confirmar persistencia disponible para alertas, historial, bitacora y metricas; universo real de tablas/logs de sincronizacion; contrato de Servidores_Conexiones; tablas/capacidades RBAC; scheduler/jobs; cobertura de Compras_Sync_Log, Comercial_SyncLog_v2 y Sync_Logs; tipos de sync y actividad reciente; contexto de Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad. No modificar codigo ni datos. No DDL/DML. No Production. No Mongo. No conexiones LIVE.

queries.name: database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, GETDATE() AS sql_now

queries.name: control_monitor_table_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Centro%Control%' OR t.name LIKE '%Alerta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Historial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Metrica%' OR t.name LIKE '%Health%' OR t.name LIKE '%Monitor%' ORDER BY s.name,t.name

queries.name: control_monitor_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Centro%Control%' OR t.name LIKE '%Alerta%' OR t.name LIKE '%Bitacora%' OR t.name LIKE '%Historial%' OR t.name LIKE '%Metrica%' OR t.name LIKE '%Health%' OR t.name LIKE '%Monitor%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: sync_source_tables
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name IN ('Compras_Sync_Log','Comercial_SyncLog_v2','Sync_Logs','Servidores_Conexiones') OR t.name LIKE '%Sync%Log%' OR t.name LIKE '%Sincron%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: sync_source_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Compras_Sync_Log','Comercial_SyncLog_v2','Sync_Logs','Servidores_Conexiones') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: sync_recent_row_counts
queries.sql: SELECT 'Compras_Sync_Log' AS source_table, COUNT(*) AS rows_24h FROM Compras_Sync_Log WHERE COALESCE(updated_at, created_at, GETDATE()) >= DATEADD(HOUR,-24,GETDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Comercial_SyncLog_v2', COUNT(*) FROM Comercial_SyncLog_v2 WHERE COALESCE(updated_at, created_at, GETDATE()) >= DATEADD(HOUR,-24,GETDATE())

queries.name: rbac_table_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name LIKE '%RBAC%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permis%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Accion%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: rbac_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%RBAC%' OR t.name LIKE '%Permis%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' OR t.name LIKE '%Accion%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: scheduler_table_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t WHERE t.name LIKE '%Scheduler%' OR t.name LIKE '%Job%' OR t.name LIKE '%Automat%' ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: scheduler_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name LIKE '%Scheduler%' OR t.name LIKE '%Job%' OR t.name LIKE '%Automat%' ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: operational_turns_schema
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') ORDER BY c.column_id

constraints: Do not modify Universal Worker structure
Preserve exact SQL outputs in terminal result
